en: The image depicts a black-and-white photograph of a group of uniformed soldiers standing in line outside a large institutional building, possibly a barracks or government facility, with early 20th-century European architectural features such as high-pitched tiled roofs, large chimneys, and dormer windows. There are several other figures visible further down the street, including a person with a horse-drawn cart. The overall atmosphere is formal and orderly.
